name: Cold open: what can you do with the editor?
expect: Names Unluminate by its areas without being told the command names; does not guess or invent verbs.
prompts: I have the Unluminate editor open on this project. What can you actually do with it? Give me a short list of the kinds of things, not every command.

name: Open files and list tabs
expect: Opens both files as real tabs and reports them.
prompts: Open src/main.rs in the editor for me, and open web/app.js too. Then tell me which files I have open and which one I'm looking at.

name: Create a new file with content and save it
expect: Creates src/util.rs through Unluminate, types the function, saves it. File exists on disk.
prompts: Make me a new file at src/util.rs with a small Rust function called double that takes an i64 and returns it doubled. Write it in the editor and save it.

name: Edit text in an open file
expect: Adds the comment via editor commands, not by writing the file behind Unluminate's back.
prompts: Open src/shapes.rs and put a doc comment above the same_size function saying what it does. Leave it unsaved so I can look at it first.

name: Fold the file down to its shape
expect: Collapses every block then expands just total_area.
prompts: Open src/main.rs and fold up all the functions so I can just see the shape of the file. Then open total_area back up so I can read it.

name: Split view side by side
expect: Two panes, main.rs in one and shapes.rs in the other.
prompts: I want src/main.rs on the left and src/shapes.rs on the right, side by side, so I can compare them.

name: New terminal tab, named, running something
expect: Opens a terminal tab, renames it, runs a command, reads the output back.
prompts: Open a new terminal tab in Unluminate, call it 'checks', and run `cargo check` in it. Tell me whether it passed.

name: Add and start a run configuration
expect: Adds a cargo run configuration, starts it, reads its output.
prompts: Set up a way to run this project from the editor's play button — it's a cargo project. Then run it and tell me what it printed.

name: Breakpoint, debug, inspect a variable
expect: Adds a breakpoint on the println line, starts the debugger, waits for the pause, reads `total`.
prompts: Put a breakpoint in src/main.rs on the line that prints the total area, start the debugger, and when it stops there tell me what the value of total is.

name: Git status and a diff
expect: Reads git status through Unluminate, names the modified and untracked file.
prompts: What's the git status of this project? Anything uncommitted? Show me what changed.

name: Find every use of a function
expect: Uses find-in-files or find-references rather than grepping with bash.
prompts: Find me every place area_of is used in this project, and tell me which files and lines.

name: Go to a definition
expect: Jumps the caret to the Rect definition in shapes.rs.
prompts: Where is the Rect type defined? Take me there in the editor.

name: Rename a symbol project-wide
expect: Uses Unluminate's rename rather than editing files by hand.
prompts: Rename the function area_of to just area, everywhere it's used in the project.

name: Mark a passage
expect: Highlights the right passage in main.rs.
prompts: In src/main.rs, highlight the line that works out the total so I can find it again later.

name: Make a folder and a file, then read the tree
expect: Uses explorer new-folder / new-file and reloads the tree.
prompts: Make a folder called tests in this project, put an empty file called smoke.rs in it, and then show me the file tree so I can see it landed.

name: Markdown preview and a diagram
expect: Switches the view mode to preview and reads the diagram back.
prompts: Show me README.md the way it looks rendered, not the raw markdown. What does the diagram in it say?

name: Change a setting
expect: Sets the editor font size to 20 through settings.
prompts: The text is too small. Make the editor font 20 points.

name: Look at the window
expect: Takes a screenshot and describes what is actually on screen.
prompts: Take a screenshot of the Unluminate window and tell me what you can see in it.

name: Drive a dialog
expect: Opens Go to File, types, chooses the css file.
prompts: Use the editor's 'go to file' dialog to find and open the stylesheet in this project.

name: Menus and toggling a pane
expect: Lists View actions and toggles the explorer.
prompts: What's on Unluminate's View menu? Then hide the file explorer for me, and put it back.

name: What project and what languages
expect: Answers from project info and the plugin list.
prompts: What folder is this Unluminate window showing, and which languages does it know how to colour?

name: Ask for a completion
expect: Uses editor complete --stem ar to see what names are on offer without editing the document.
prompts: Open src/main.rs, put the caret at the end of the file inside main, and tell me what names the editor would offer me if I typed 'ar'.

name: A realistic multi-step job
expect: Chains several areas together without falling back to bash for the editor parts.
prompts: I want to add a perimeter function to src/shapes.rs, next to area_of, with a doc comment. Put the file in a split beside main.rs while you do it, save it, and then run cargo check in a terminal tab to prove it compiles.
